game_concept: A racing platformer set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the royal scribe ahead. Then check the shield value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving shield that move the royal scribe forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Market Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
